messages:
ivy: Kicking off a short thread to finalize the base image rebuild + keystore flightplan. Goal: minimal blast radius, full audit trail, and a clear rollback path.
tom: Quick ask: will the rebuild change syscall surface or just libs? need to know if seccomp profile must be relaxed.
ivy: Only lib updates (openssl, curl). Seccomp tightened to drop CAP_NET_RAW and a few file perms. No syscall whitelist changes expected. We'll run syscall smoke on staging.
rachel: For KMS: plan is to create new key version v2 in HSM and rotate cosign signer to use v2. Keep v1 active for 72h. Key ops must be audited to long-term bucket.
sec-bot: advisory: previous rotation attempts failed when RBAC allowed broad groups. Recommend binding signer role to single SA and add condition on resource.name.
tom: I'll draft an RBAC snippet: `bindings: - role: roles/cloudkms.signer members: ["serviceAccount:cosign-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] condition: expression: resource.name.startsWith("projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/cosign")`
ivy: Perfect. Also add an audit sink filter for AsymmetricSign/Verify and IAMPolicySet. Keep retention 90d.
rachel: Ops notes: - pre-warm node KMS clients - increase pull secret TTL to 2h - perform blue/green image roll for canary nodes
sre-oncall: Schedule: staging canary Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC, prod rollout Wed 01:30-04:30 UTC. I'll be present for both windows.
tom: Smoke tests for canary: `cosign verify --key ksm://cosign/v2 <image>`; `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:\"AsymmetricSign\" AND resource.labels.crypto_key_id:cosign" --limit 5`; image pull + healthcheck.
sec-bot: monitor-config: added alert keystore-sign-errors threshold 2/5m -> @sre-oncall.
ivy: Rollback plan summary: 1) revert deployment annotation to previous image tag 2) rebind old key by restoring prior RBAC 3) mark new key version disabled 4) run post-rollback verification steps.
rachel: Vulnerability triage: we'll run SBOM diff pre/post and block if any new critical CVEs. Add an automated blocker: if `sbom-diff --critical > 0` then stop rollout.
tom: Small edge case: image registry rate limits might trigger during parallel canaries. Recommend staggering canaries by cohort of 10 pods.
sre-oncall: Noted. I'll add the stagger to the runbook and watch audit logs during canary.
ivy: Owners: tom -> RBAC PR, rachel -> keystore rotation scripts + audit sink, sre-oncall -> windows and runbook. I'll open PRs and post links here.
